general.name: Order Cleanup
general.title: Order Cleanup
general.description: Clear all orders, customers, documents and reset number generators

orders.title: Orders
orders.warning: This action is irreversible and will permanently delete all order data.
orders.description: Clicking the button below will permanently delete:

item.orders: All orders and related data (line items, transactions, deliveries, addresses)
item.documents: All order documents (invoices, credit notes, etc.)
item.media: All document media files (PDFs) from the media library
item.numberRanges: Number range counters for orders and documents (will restart from the configured start value)

modal.title: Clear all orders?
modal.body: This will permanently delete ALL orders, documents and media files, and reset all order and document number counters. This action cannot be undone.

notifications.successMessage: All orders, documents and number range counters have been cleared.

customers.title: Customers
customers.warning: This action is irreversible and will permanently delete all customer data.
customers.description: Clicking the button below will permanently delete:

item.customers: All customers and their login credentials
item.numberRanges: Customer number range counter (will restart from the configured start value)

modal.title: Clear all customers?
modal.body: This will permanently delete ALL customers and their addresses, and reset the customer number counter. This action cannot be undone.

notifications.successMessage: All customers and the customer number range counter have been cleared.

notifications.errorMessage: An error occurred during cleanup. Please check the logs.
